media.alt_text: Rows of vermillion torii gates at Fushimi Inari Taisha in Kyoto

caption.body: Thousands of vermillion torii gates winding up the mountain behind Fushimi Inari. Go as early as you can — it's a different experience without the crowds. The full Kyoto guide on the site covers where to eat GF nearby.
